children.label: 🏫 School Integration Program (SIP)
children.response: The V.18 School Integrated Program (SIP) brings 3D, AR, VR & AI-powered learning directly into your school classrooms without altering your existing textbook curriculum. What would you like to know about SIP?

children.label: What is V.18 SIP?
children.response: V.18 SIP is a complete tech-enabled academic solution that integrates immersive 3D lessons, Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), and AI learning analytics into your classrooms without changing your existing school curriculum or timetable.

children.label: Grades, Boards & Subjects Covered
children.response:
📚 SIP Academic Coverage:
• Grades: 8th, 9th, and 10th Grade
• Boards: CBSE & Karnataka State Board
• Subjects: Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology), Mathematics, Social Science, and English.

children.label: Will it change our school syllabus?
children.response: No, not at all. SIP does not change your textbook syllabus or school routine. It supports your teachers with 3D animated concepts, interactive simulations, and virtual science labs aligned directly with NEP 2020 guidelines.

children.label: Teacher Training & Enablement
children.response:
👨‍🏫 Teacher Enablement under SIP:
• Ready-to-use digital lesson plans
• Smart board compatible 3D teaching resources
• Hands-on teacher training and continuous academic support.

children.label: Benefits for School Management
children.response:
🏆 Core Benefits for Your School:
• Brand Value: Establish your school with modern AR/VR smart classrooms
• Admissions: Attract more student admissions
• Results: Improve board exam scores by replacing memorization with visual clarity
• Parent Satisfaction: Deliver visible technology-driven learning.

children.label: Devices & Platforms Supported
children.response:
💻 Supported Platforms & Devices:
• Smart Boards (Interactive lessons)
• VR Headsets (360° virtual world tours & labs)
• Tablets & Mobiles (AR activities on the go)
• Windows PC, Web Browsers & TV Screen Cast.

children.label: Plans & Packages Available
children.response:
📦 3 Flexible Onboarding Packages:
1. Software Only: For schools with existing smart boards
2. Hardware + Software: Pre-configured smart boards, VR headsets, and tablets with software
3. Complete Immersive Lab Setup: Full lab installation, hardware, software, and training.
(Available in Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, and Elite plans).
